entries.title: Manage your Contracting fleet
entries.description: Maintain machines, categories and implements, assign drivers, and record service intervals and category rates. Retire fleet items while keeping their history.

entries.title: Resolve hour reading exceptions
entries.description: Review disputed machine hours and photo verification warnings in Contracting. Inspect photos, recheck verification, and correct or confirm readings with a recorded reason.

entries.title: Organise Contracting customers and work types
entries.description: Maintain customer contact details and their farms in Contracting. Add work types and deactivate those no longer offered.

entries.title: Filter users by business access
entries.description: See whether each user has Equipment access, Contracting access, both or neither. Combine Mode filters to narrow the user list.

entries.title: Specify quote delivery terms
entries.description: Choose delivery included, an additional charge, customer collection or to be confirmed, with matching terms on quote PDFs. Quotes awaiting delivery confirmation cannot be accepted.

entries.title: Track Supply work
entries.description: Select Supply when planning product labor, adding quote work items and recording job work times. Supply also appears in department timing and build metrics.

entries.title: Maintain labor rates centrally
entries.description: Administrators can update department cost and billing rates, consumables percentages, management overhead and working-day hours, with changes recorded in Audit. Product estimates and new quote work items use the saved rates.

entries.title: Estimate labor from days and staff
entries.description: Enter days per staff member and staff numbers for each product's labor. Cost estimates now include consumables and management overhead, and flag missing labor rates.

entries.title: Switch between businesses reliably
entries.description: Users with access to both businesses can switch between Equipment and Contracting from the sidebar without an error.

entries.title: Retry pages that fail to load
entries.description: A failed page load now shows a clear error page with a retry option instead of a blank screen.

entries.title: Find Contracting machines in the field
entries.description: Search machines by code, filter by category, and view their latest synced hours and reading history. Fleet details and histories opened while connected remain available offline.

entries.title: Capture machine hours offline
entries.description: Type hour meter readings and optionally attach a photo, even without signal. Captures stay saved on your phone and sync when the app is open with a connection.

entries.title: Resolve queued reading problems
entries.description: Use Needs attention to review captures that could not sync. Dispute an incorrect previous reading, retry syncing or discard a capture.

entries.title: Specify quote delivery terms
entries.description: Choose delivery included, an additional charge, customer collection or to be confirmed directly in the quote editor. Quotes awaiting delivery confirmation cannot be accepted.

entries.title: Use current rates for quote work
entries.description: New quote work items use the department billing rates maintained in the labor rate card. Supply is now available as a work department.
